headline: Ransomware Attack Disrupts Operations at Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd.
body: Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd., an established supplier in the automotive sector, has been hit by a ransomware attack that disrupted its operations. The attack necessitated the isolation of servers and a temporary suspension of production activities. Taigene Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. is a vital player in the automotive supply chain, known for its reliable delivery of essential components. The company is actively working to address the security breach and resume its operations as quickly as possible. Efforts are underway to secure the affected systems and restore normalcy. While the attack has posed challenges, Taigene has not indicated any long-term impacts on its supply commitments.
